## My Boogie by the Bay 2026 Weekend Guide

### ✈️ Friday, October 9
* **10:00 AM - 1:00 PM** | 🎓 *Jordan & Tatiana Intensive* (Regency Ballroom) - *Note: Early arrival required!*
* **2:15 PM** | ✈️ **Flight Landing Deadline**
* **2:00 PM - 3:00 PM** | 👟 Intermediate Competitors Workshop (Sandpebble ABC)
* **6:30 PM** | 🏆 **Intermediate/Masters Strictly Swing (Prelims & Finals)** (Grand Ballroom)
* **12:00 AM** | 🕺 Late Night Social Dance

### 🕺 Saturday, October 10
* **11:00 AM** | 👟 Intermediate Competitors Workshop (Sandpebble ABC)
* **2:15 PM** | 🏆 **Intermediate & Masters J&J (Prelims/Semis)** (Grand Ballroom)
* **7:30 PM** | ✨ **Saturday Night Dance - Dress to Impress** (Grand Ballroom)

### 🏆 Sunday, October 11
* **2:15 PM** | 🥇 **Intermediate Jack & Jill - Finals** (Grand Ballroom)
* **3:00 PM** | 🥇 **Masters Jack & Jill - Finals** (Grand Ballroom)
* **6:00 PM** | 🎖️ **Awards Ceremony**
